stories.title: Mercedes Moné vs Willow Nightingale AEW Rivalry
stories.tldr: Mercedes Moné attacked AEW Women's World Champion Willow Nightingale just hours before AEW Dynamite on August 12, 2026, posting a video on social media showing the aftermath and taunting Nightingale ahead of their title match at All In in London on August 30. Moné referenced a three-year grudge stemming from a 2023 NJPW tournament loss to Nightingale that resulted in an ankle injury, promising to "take away that damn smile once and for all."

stories.title: Darby Allin WWE Counterprogramming Comments
stories.tldr: AEW star Darby Allin has expressed a surprisingly positive view of WWE counter-programming AEW events, stating he loves the competition because it pushes wrestlers to do their best work when their backs are against the wall. The comments come as AEW All Out and WWE/AAA Worlds Collide are scheduled for the same weekend in Chicago in September 2026. Allin also emphasized that wrestling isn't his entire life and he maintains perspective on the ongoing industry rivalry.

stories.title: AEW TBS Championship Match
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a four-way TBS Championship match for the August 19 episode of Dynamite in Baltimore, Maryland, where champion Maya World will defend against Hikaru Shida, Kris Statlander, and Persephone. The match culminates weeks of escalating tension and interference between the four competitors, with complex histories including Shida's original title win, World's subsequent capture of the championship, and ongoing personal rivalries among all parties involved.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Ticket Sales and Search Interest
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite is experiencing increased search interest, up 20% over the last 90 days and 30% compared to the same period last year, though it remains significantly behind WWE RAW in overall search volume. Ticket sales for tonight's Las Vegas show at the Pearl Concert Theater are tracking slightly behind the previous visit to the venue, with 1,680 tickets distributed so far, below the year-to-date average of 3,264 tickets per event.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Returns to AEW
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland made his return to AEW Dynamite after being absent since losing to Will Ospreay in the Owen Hart Foundation Tournament finals at Forbidden Door. Swerve confronted the AEW World Trios Champions Hangman Adam Page and Brodido, setting up what appears to be a trios championship match at AEW All In London. Speculation suggests Swerve may partner with recently freed WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods of the New Day for the match.

stories.title: AEW Bandido Arena Mexico Luchador Discussion
stories.tldr: AEW star Bandido explained that wrestling at Arena Mexico is a career-defining achievement that separates "real luchadores" from other wrestlers, comparing its significance to Madison Square Garden in the US and Tokyo Dome in Japan. Bandido also shared his personal journey of secretly training in wrestling after his father initially opposed his ambitions, eventually finding natural talent that his first coach recognized immediately.

stories.title: AEW Collision Security Incident August 8
stories.tldr: AEW Collision experienced a backstage security lockdown on August 8 after someone called in a threat, initially feared to involve an armed person. The situation was quickly resolved when security discovered the concern was merely a man in a hoodie carrying a duffel bag, causing minimal disruption to talent or broadcast operations.

stories.title: CM Punk Reaching Out to Released WWE Star
stories.tldr: Zoey Stark was among 22 WWE talents released as part of post-WrestleMania budget cuts while recovering from a serious knee injury. The former NXT star received significant support from top wrestlers including Becky Lynch, CM Punk, and Cody Rhodes, who reached out during her rehab and after her release to provide guidance and encouragement.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite August 12, 2026 Episode Coverage
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland made a surprise return to confront the new AEW World Trios Champions and set up a title defense for Saturday's Collision. Kenny Omega and Will Ospreay's world title program lacked clear storytelling direction in an awkward opening segment. MJF dominated a three-way match to secure the No. 2 spot in the Casino Gauntlet at All In.

stories.title: AEW All In London Event Announcements
stories.tldr: AEW has booked two major championship matches for All In London on August 30. Kyle Fletcher will defend his International Championship in a three-way against former champions Konosuke Takeshita and Kazuchika Okada, while TNT Champion Kevin Knight faces Darby Allin in a Falls Count Anywhere match. Both matches were announced on the August 12 episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: Jim Ross AEW Broadcaster Brain Surgery
stories.tldr: Jim Ross' brain surgery on August 12 was successful, with his podcast co-host Conrad Thompson reporting that the 74-year-old is expected to be discharged by Friday. The procedure to insert a shunt for draining excess brain fluid went well, and Ross is hopeful about making the trip to AEW All In London on August 30. Wrestling legends including Ric Flair have sent their well-wishes for his recovery.

stories.title: AEW Collision August 15, 2026
stories.tldr: Three major matches were added to Saturday's AEW Collision taping. The newly crowned Trios Champions Hangman Page, Brody King and Bandido will defend against The Lethal Twist after a confrontation on Dynamite. Mercedes Mone faces Zayda Steel, and the Women's World Tag Team Champions Divine Dominion will compete in non-title action.

stories.title: MJF Casino Gauntlet Spot at AEW All In
stories.tldr: MJF won the No. 2 spot in the Casino Gauntlet at AEW All In by defeating Mike Bailey and Nick Wayne, employing a strategy of letting his opponents wear each other down before striking. He then issued warnings to Andrade El Idolo, Kenny Omega, and Will Ospreay, declaring himself unstoppable and promising to leave London with the World Championship contract.

stories.title: Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed to AEW
stories.tldr: Sources have told reporters that Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed are expected to join AEW soon, though neither star has officially confirmed signing with the company. The report suggests their arrival could happen in the near term, adding weight to speculation that began when they were announced as captains for the Jericho Cruise in November.

stories.title: WWE Raw Celebrity Guest Announcement
stories.tldr: WWE announced that TikTok star and comedian Matt Mathews will make a guest appearance on the September 7 edition of Monday Night Raw in his hometown of Birmingham, Alabama. Mathews, who previously appeared on NXT as a judge for Mr. NXT and later got physically involved in a tag team match, has nearly 8 million followers on TikTok and rose to fame during the pandemic with viral farm-themed comedy videos. The announcement has drawn significant fan backlash, with viewers criticizing WWE's continued reliance on celebrity appearances, though the company has not yet revealed what specific role Mathews will play on the show.

stories.title: Oba Femi Heel Turn Pitch
stories.tldr: Former WWE Champion Jinder Mahal has pitched a heel turn for rising star Oba Femi, suggesting he align with Paul Heyman and follow a similar trajectory to Brock Lesnar's early WWE run by dominating opponents until the crowd naturally turns him babyface. Mahal also defended Roman Reigns against criticism of being overrated, stating that the current version of Reigns is unmatched in presentation, psychology, communication, and aura. Additionally, Mahal praised NXT head writer Johnny Russo's promo coaching to tryout attendees, emphasizing the importance of conveying emotions and authentic storytelling over polished wrestling clichés.

stories.title: Johnny Gargano Father Cancer Diagnosis
stories.tldr: WWE star Johnny Gargano publicly revealed that his 84-year-old father, Frank, was diagnosed with Stage 4 lung and prostate cancer over the past year. In an emotional post on social media, Gargano paid tribute to his father's influence on his life and wrestling career, reflecting on how his father nurtured his passion for wrestling from childhood and remains a source of inspiration despite undergoing chemotherapy and radiation treatment.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes and Oba Femi Tag Team Championship
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes and Oba Femi will team up for the first time ever to challenge The Vision's Bron Breakker and Austin Theory for the WWE World Tag Team Championship this Friday in Boston. The match will take place as a dark match after the SmackDown broadcast and is not expected to air on television. The pairing is intriguing given that Rhodes and Femi previously wrestled to a no contest last December, and the bout is likely designed to further build the growing tension between Femi and Breakker.

stories.title: Donovan Dijak WWE Return Interest
stories.tldr: Donovan Dijak has expressed openness to returning to WWE under the right circumstances and potentially reuniting with his former tag team partner Baron Corbin, with whom he formed The Skyscrapers in MLW. While the duo only had about a year together and roughly a dozen matches before Corbin's recent WWE return, Dijak believes they barely scratched the surface of their potential and remains open to continuing their partnership in any company, though intellectual property concerns regarding The Skyscrapers name remain unclear.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Vince McMahon Return Speculation
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff expressed his belief that Vince McMahon will not make a significant return to WWE or the public spotlight, saying any potential comeback would be limited to occasional appearances like Hall of Fame events. Bischoff argued that the baggage surrounding McMahon outweighs any business benefit, and he views a return to the TKO board as even less likely. In separate comments, Bischoff also discussed Roman Reigns, saying he finds the champion creatively boring despite respecting him as a person and acknowledging his strong merchandise sales and star power.

stories.title: Lexis King Tribute to AEW's Rebel
stories.tldr: Lexis King paid tribute to AEW's Rebel during his August 11 NXT match against Lucien Price by wearing a wristband featuring her name and a heart. King responded to a fan who noticed the tribute with a message of support, as Rebel currently battles terminal ALS. King also commented on the situation involving AJ Styles' son Avery and drew parallels to his own experience as a second-generation wrestler.

stories.title: WWE Faction Name Change Due to Bloodline
stories.tldr: WWE initially planned to name the Brawling Brutes "Bloody Brutes" but scrapped the name due to similarity with The Bloodline faction. Ridge Holland confirmed the change in a recent interview and also revealed that a planned breakup storyline for the group was dropped because audience interest was lacking, with Holland noting he received minimal crowd reaction during that period.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Post-Vince McMahon WWE Evolution
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes discussed how WWE has significantly evolved under Nick Khan and Paul "Triple H" Levesque's leadership to better accommodate talent with families compared to the Vince McMahon era. Speaking on his podcast with Santino Marella, Rhodes highlighted reduced live event schedules and a more family-friendly backstage environment as major improvements. Marella reflected on the difficult "dichotomy" of loving his WWE career while missing time with his daughter, but expressed gratitude that his daughter Bianca now works in WWE NXT and the TNA-WWE partnership allows them to see each other regularly.

stories.title: John Cena Coyote vs Acme Comments
stories.tldr: John Cena defended Warner Bros. Discovery's controversial decision to shelve Coyote vs. Acme, explaining that actors have limited control over what happens to their completed work once it's owned by studios. While he naturally wanted audiences to see the film, Cena emphasized his responsibility ends with delivering quality work during production, and he compared the situation to building a custom car for someone else who owns it. The film eventually found a lifeline when Ketchup Entertainment acquired it and will release on August 28.

stories.title: WWE Main Event Scene Age Analysis
stories.tldr: WWE's main event scene features several wrestlers in or approaching their 40s, including Cody Rhodes, Roman Reigns, Seth Rollins, and CM Punk, prompting discussion about whether the company is aging like the Attitude Era or failing to build the next generation. WWE has several promising young talents waiting in the wings including Oba Femi, Bron Breakker, Trick Williams, Je'von Evans, and Rhea Ripley who could become the next face of the company.

stories.title: WWE Frustrated Stars and Rumors
stories.tldr: Multiple WWE wrestlers are reportedly frustrated with their booking, with Austin Theory receiving a major push that has drawn the ire of stars like Bron Breakker and Damian Priest. The Bella Twins and Natalya continue pushing for a Total Divas revival, while Zilla Fatu made his NXT debut without a name change and won't be rushed to the main roster despite a potential Bloodline spot.

stories.title: WWE Raw Superstars on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Several WWE Raw Superstars are advertised for the August 14 episode of WWE SmackDown in Boston, Massachusetts, including a post-show dark match main event featuring WWE World Tag-Team Champions The Vision taking on Cody Rhodes and Oba Femi. The televised portion features three championship matches: Baron Corbin defending the United States Championship against Carmelo Hayes, Tiffany Stratton defending the Women's United States Championship against Jacy Jayne, and a three-way tag-team championship match for the WWE Tag-Team titles.

stories.title: Ethan Page WWE Prime Career Status
stories.tldr: Ethan Page, who was called up to WWE Raw following WrestleMania 42 after 20 years wrestling across multiple promotions, still experiences nervousness despite his extensive experience. The 36-year-old Canadian star acknowledges he's not in his physical prime but believes his prime as a performer is just beginning. Though he's been taking losses on Raw lately, Page continues to appear on television weekly and hopes to showcase his exceptional promo abilities that have elevated his career.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Women's World Championship Defense
stories.tldr: NXT star Karmen Petrovic has called out Women's World Champion Liv Morgan, expressing a desire to challenge her for the title and noting that she doesn't see Morgan defending the championship frequently. Petrovic, who works across multiple wrestling brands including NXT, Evolve, and AAA, made her comments on the Battleground Podcast when discussing her dream opponents. Morgan's title reign has seen limited televised defenses, with her first on-camera defense occurring over 100 days into her reign at SummerSlam against IYO SKY.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu WWE NXT Debut
stories.tldr: The Usos and Jacob Fatu acknowledged Zilla's debut with Bloodline symbolism on social media, sparking speculation about his future with the faction. Cruz Montana responded positively to the physicality despite the interruption, while Grayson Waller expressed frustration at another Anoa'i family member joining WWE. WWE kept Zilla's established name rather than rebranding him, and his immediate title challenge leaves the NXT Championship picture wide open heading into Heatwave.

stories.title: AJ Styles Son Avery Styles Controversy
stories.tldr: Nic Nemeth has become the latest established wrestler to weigh in on the Avery Styles controversy, suggesting the 19-year-old should have addressed the situation himself rather than having his father respond. Nemeth also criticized Cody Rhodes' argument that Avery had already "paid his dues" through his father's sacrifices, saying that logic doesn't apply to showing respect for the business among peers. Meanwhile, AJ Styles recently visited The Dungeon to train students alongside Avery, and second-generation wrestlers including Lexis King have rallied behind Avery with a unified social media statement.

stories.title: Logan Paul and Bron Breakker WWE Backstage Issues
stories.tldr: Logan Paul has responded to Coachman's claims of backstage friction between himself and Bron Breakker with a dismissive "wtf lol" on social media, suggesting he was unaware of or confused by the allegation. Paul's brief reaction indicates he didn't recognize the story being told about him, though it remains unclear whether this shuts down the rumor or if Breakker will address it directly.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown August 7 Viewership
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on August 7 saw viewership climb to 1.470 million, marking an increase from the previous week's 1.379 million viewers. The show's demo rating also improved to 0.35 in the 18-49 demographic, up from 0.31 the week prior. The Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton segment dominated YouTube viewership among SmackDown clips.

stories.title: WWE NXT Women's Speed Championship
stories.tldr: The Women's Speed Championship, introduced in 2024, will be unified with the Women's North American Championship at NXT Heatwave, likely ending the title's run. Candice LeRae was the inaugural champion, followed by Sol Ruca, Fallon Henley, and current champion Wren Sinclair. If Zaria wins the unification match, she would be recognized as the final Women's Speed Champion, mirroring how championship retirements have been handled in WWE's past.

stories.title: Malakai Black Post-WWE Independent Return
stories.tldr: Malakai Black, formerly known as Aleister Black, has announced his return to professional wrestling following his WWE release in April 2026. He will compete on PROGRESS Wrestling's Odyssey Tour in the United Kingdom in early September, marking his first matches back on the independent circuit. Black is returning with a new shaved-head look and championship aspirations, though specific opponents have not yet been announced.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo CMLL 93 Anniversary
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo has been announced for a return match against Volador Jr. at CMLL's 93rd Anniversary event on September 18, 2026 at Arena Mexico. The card also features a four-team Lucha De Apuestas eliminator match involving Mistico and Averno, with the winners advancing to a singles bout where masks and hair will be on the line.

stories.title: Tessa Blanchard MLW Negotiations
stories.tldr: MLW founder Court Bauer has confirmed that the promotion is actively in negotiations with Tessa Blanchard, the former TNA World Champion who departed the company in June 2026. While nothing has been finalized, Bauer indicated that Blanchard has been a consideration for MLW since becoming a free agent, and revealed that she was originally supposed to join the promotion during its 2017 relaunch but scheduling conflicts prevented it. Blanchard has since been focusing her career on CMLL in Mexico, where she stated she intends to remain 100% committed to pursuing her goals.

stories.title: WWE NXT Lockdown and TNA Connection
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling is hosting "The Hardy Party" on Friday, August 21, in Milwaukee at Casablanca Restaurant, featuring the reigning TNA World Tag Team Champions Jeff and Matt Hardy with special guest Mustafa Ali. The event includes a Q&A session, photos, autographs, and giveaways including complimentary Lockdown tickets, taking place just two days before TNA Lockdown 2026 on August 23 in Chicago.

stories.title: Los Perros del Mal AAA Revival
stories.tldr: Los Perros del Mal's revival in AAA was presented as a "one and done" proposition that could have ended after a single appearance if the Mexican crowd rejected it. The faction's June 20 debut was a massive success, garnering 15 million social media views within 12 hours across WWE and AAA platforms, validating the decision to resurrect the legendary group. Current member Karmen Petrovic revealed the immense pressure of reviving a faction with over two decades of wrestling history and legacy.

stories.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36
stories.tldr: Yota Tsuji and Ryohei Oiwa have advanced from the A Block of NJPW G1 Climax 36 with 12 points each, earning their spots in the semifinals. The B Block will conclude on August 13, with four wrestlers currently tied at 10 points vying for the remaining two semifinal spots. The tournament will culminate with semifinals on August 15 and finals on August 16, with the winner earning a title shot at Tsuji's IWGP Heavyweight Championship if he doesn't win the tournament.

stories.title: Title Changes August 12
stories.tldr: August 12 is one of the busiest days for professional wrestling title changes, with approximately 266 notable championship changes recorded on this date throughout history. Major title changes on this day include Masahiro Chono winning the NWA World Heavyweight Title in 1992, Chris Jericho winning the WCW Cruiserweight Title in 1997, and Kurt Angle winning both the TNA X-Division and Tag Team Titles in 2007. The day has seen title changes across multiple wrestling promotions including WWE, WCW, ECW, ROH, TNA, CMLL, AJPW, NJPW, and AAA.

stories.title: TNA Hard Justice 2007 Flashback
stories.tldr: TNA Hard Justice 2007 featured the Doomsday Chamber of Blood match on August 12, 2007, with AJ Styles, Sting, Christian Cage, Abyss, Tomko, and Andrew Martin competing in a cage match where wrestlers had to bleed before being pinned. Dave Meltzer awarded the match just one star, criticizing it for weapon and glass spot overkill that left the crowd numb to the action. The match is remembered as one of the worst on the card, with Andrew Martin's poor performance foreshadowing his brief TNA tenure before his tragic death in 2009.

stories.title: Santino Marella Is Now ‘Capable’ of Wrestling Again, Has One Beautiful Reason
stories.tldr: Santino Marella says he is now healthy enough to return to wrestling after undergoing stem cell treatments, PRP therapy, and red light therapy that have significantly improved his physical condition. His primary motivation for a comeback is to wrestle in front of his seven-year-old son, who has never seen him perform live. Marella's full-time career ended over a decade ago due to neck surgery and back injuries that led WWE to not renew his contract in 2016, though he did compete in an NXT match in July 2025.

stories.title: AEW Is Assembling The Strongest Tag Team Division In Wrestling
stories.tldr: AEW is building the strongest tag team division in professional wrestling by assembling an elite roster of teams including current champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage, the Young Bucks, Motor City Machine Guns, FTR, the Rascalz, and Brodido. The company is reversing a trend of tag team neglect seen in WWE, positioning itself to create a potential boom period for tag team wrestling with multiple generational dream match possibilities.

stories.title: Leela Feist Says Collarbone Injury “Put A Fire Inside Me” Ahead Of Grand Slam 2
stories.tldr: Leela Feist will finally make her Grand Slam debut at Grand Slam 2 on August 15 after a collarbone injury forced her off the inaugural card two years ago. Watching the first event from ringside while recovering fueled her motivation to return and compete. She faces Shawna Reed, who defeated her in their prior singles encounter, with additional championship matches headlining the event at Kokomo Municipal Stadium.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez’s WWE NXT August 11, 2026 report
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez has published his detailed report on WWE NXT's August 11, 2026 episode for subscribers. The report provides his professional analysis and coverage of that night's programming, though specific match details and storyline developments are not included in this announcement. Subscribers can access the full breakdown through the premium service.

stories.title: General Wrestling News and Updates
stories.tldr: Jim Ross's successful brain surgery has prompted colleagues to reflect on his impact. Kevin Nash credited Ross with early career support in WCW, while multiple WWE and AEW developments have emerged, including Je'Von Evans calling out Lil Uzi Vert for a WWE match and speculation about Brock Rechsteiner potentially joining WWE within months.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio AAA GM Role and Retirement Thoughts
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio opened up about his ongoing internal battle with retirement, saying his body is signaling it may be time but he still doesn't feel ready to quit. In his AAA GM role, he's deliberately stepping aside from the luchador tournament to give younger talent a shot at Roman Reigns, viewing it as an opportunity to showcase the next generation of lucha libre stars.

stories.title: AEW's MVP Explains Why New Day Leaving WWE Is 'Uncharted Territory'
stories.tldr: MVP explained that WWE's corporate restructuring under TKO has created "uncharted territory" for talent negotiations, with the New Day reportedly offered a 50 percent pay cut rather than retaining their existing deals. MVP praised Kofi and Woods for being in a strong enough financial position to walk away rather than accept disrespect, while noting that WWE contracts have historically been "horribly one-sided" in the company's favor.

stories.title: CM Punk appearance boosts WWE NXT house show ticket sales
stories.tldr: CM Punk's announcement for an NXT house show in Petersburg, Virginia on August 15 has already driven ticket sales up by 222 in just a few days, bringing the total to 1,483 distributed tickets. The appearance continues to demonstrate strong fan interest in Punk's full-time return to WWE competition.

stories.title: New Day Jericho Cruise AEW
stories.tldr: Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods, formerly known as The New Day, have been announced as "Super Massive Guest Captains" for Chris Jericho's Rock 'N' Wrestling Rager at Sea cruise sailing from Miami to the Bahamas from November 7-11, 2026. The booking has reignited speculation about a potential AEW signing, though nothing has been officially confirmed. The pair left WWE in May and are now free agents following their 90-day non-compete period.

stories.title: AEW Indie Promotion Partnership
stories.tldr: One Fall Wrestling, an indie promotion owned by AEW's QT Marshall, will hold special television tapings before and after AEW Dynamite on September 9 in Athens, Georgia. The Dynamite episode, titled "Rebel Heart Dynamite," will raise awareness and funds for ALS in honor of AEW original Rebel (Tanea Brooks), who was diagnosed with the terminal disease in May. The partnership allows 1FW to showcase their talent on their biggest stage while AEW fans discover new performers, all while supporting a crucial charitable cause.

stories.title: AEW Speculation - Sheamus and FTR
stories.tldr: FTR has been booked for RevPro's 14th Anniversary show at OVO Wembley on August 29, 2026, the day before AEW All In returns to Wembley Stadium, sparking speculation about potential AEW appearances. Meanwhile, a zipline video featuring recently departed WWE star Sheamus has fueled fan speculation about a surprise AEW debut at All In: London on August 30, though the video is likely just a reference to an inside joke between Sheamus and Randy Orton.

stories.title: Anthony Henry AEW Surgery
stories.tldr: AEW and ROH star Anthony Henry announced he is undergoing surgery to address Heterotopic Ossification, a condition where bone growth in his forearm has prevented him from fully rotating his right arm. The complication stemmed from a previous bicep repair surgery and has limited him to performing at only 60% capacity. Henry hopes this upcoming procedure will resolve the issue and allow him to return to full performance level.

stories.title: Darby Allin AEW World Title Run
stories.tldr: Darby Allin has defended his brief 39-day AEW World Championship reign, telling Mark Hoke he has no regrets about burning through his energy during the run. Meanwhile, Mick Foley has praised Allin as one of the biggest stars of this generation, crediting him with taking Cactus Jack-inspired elements and combining them with superior athleticism to create his own hybrid style.

stories.title: Mick Foley AEW Commentary and Potential Match
stories.tldr: Jim Ross is undergoing brain surgery Wednesday to place a shunt that will drain excess fluid from his brain, expressing optimism despite the serious procedure. His AEW contract expires this month with no new deal signed yet. Meanwhile, Mick Foley pitched a wild MJF angle involving his friend Kenny Jordan that could potentially lead to one final match, inspired by the John Wick revenge storyline.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo AEW Injury Update
stories.tldr: Andrade's week off following Grand Slam Mexico was pre-scheduled rather than injury-related, according to backstage reports. He is expected to return to AEW programming next week and continue his feud with MJF leading into All In. His status for the Casino Gauntlet match remains unchanged.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 Ticket Sales
stories.tldr: AEW All Out 2026 has surpassed 6,160 tickets distributed at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, showing modest growth of 174 tickets over the past five days. The event trails the previous NOW Arena PPV from December 2025, which ultimately drew 8,968 tickets. Tony Khan explained that the late September date allows for proper build time between All In and All Out.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu WWE NXT Debut
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu, son of late WWE star Umaga and member of the Anoa'i family, officially debuted with WWE NXT on August 11, 2026, by interrupting the main event No. 1 contender's match between Cruz Montana and Grayson Waller. Fatu attacked both competitors and declared himself the next NXT Champion, forcing a no contest finish and throwing the title picture into chaos ahead of Heatwave on August 30. His debut came after being spotted at the WWE Performance Center and capped off his emotional farewell from the independent wrestling scene.

stories.title: The Rock Music Career Exploration
stories.tldr: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson has revealed he is actively exploring a potential music career, with a particular focus on traditional country music. The exploration was inspired by recording "Your Dad," a personal song he wrote for his daughters for the Moana: Voices Across the Ocean album. Johnson emphasized that at this stage of his career, he wants to pursue projects that genuinely excite him rather than those driven purely by commercial expectations.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair WWE Main Event Push
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair has openly stated she believes she should be positioned as a main event attraction and marketed like a champion, despite currently working in WWE's tag team division with Alexa Bliss. While acknowledging there is a bigger picture to her current run, Flair expressed confidence that fans now want to see her back in the singles title picture more than ever before, and described the past year as the most versatile of her career despite feeling written off by some.

stories.title: Patrick Clark Velveteen Dream Boxing Debut
stories.tldr: Patrick Clark, formerly known as Velveteen Dream in WWE, is making his professional boxing debut on August 29, 2026, at Duel: Arena 1 in Orlando, Florida, facing podcast host Ryan Pownall in a cruiserweight bout. The move comes five years after his 2021 WWE release and roughly 15 months after he publicly campaigned for a wrestling comeback that never materialized.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Divas Championship
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown performer Blake Monroe has expressed her desire to bring back the retired Divas Championship, joking that she would "swap out" the Women's Title for the butterfly logo design if given the opportunity. Monroe cited her admiration for legendary divas like Trish Stratus and Nikki Bella, saying the Divas Championship aesthetic would match her personal style. The Divas Championship was officially retired in 2016 when WWE introduced the new Women's Championship at WrestleMania 32.

stories.title: WWE Creative Accountability
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash criticized Triple H and WWE Creative for repeatedly blaming talent for not getting pushed instead of taking accountability for booking decisions. Nash specifically referenced comments from SummerSlam 2026 where Triple H said wrestlers need to get themselves over like Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns, and pointed to examples like Bron Breakker and Dominik Mysterio as talent allegedly underutilized by the company.

stories.title: LA Knight WWE Raw Presentation
stories.tldr: Bully Ray criticized WWE's handling of LA Knight on Raw, saying the company made a "reverse 180" with his character after his strong performance the previous week. Ray was confused why Knight didn't help Solo Sikoa in the main event and why Jacob Fatu was allowed to verbally dismantle him in a backstage segment without Knight responding, undercutting the momentum Knight had built confronting Roman Reigns about a world title shot.

stories.title: Ric Flair Rolex Watch
stories.tldr: Luxury watch dealer Roman Sharf surprised WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair with a custom Rolex watch at the National Card Convention to replace one he received from Shawn Michaels after their WrestleMania 24 retirement match in 2008 and later misplaced. The surprise, which was captured on video and has generated over three million YouTube views, moved both Flair and Sharf to tears. Sharf decided to gift the watch after learning about the missing timepiece from Steven Solomon, who manages Flair's appearances.

stories.title: Nikki Storm 24/7 Championship
stories.tldr: Nikki Storm missed throwing the 24/7 Championship into a trash can during a live WWE Raw segment in November 2022 after a perfect rehearsal take couldn't be used due to technical issues. Rather than break character, Storm kept going with the botch and later reflected that the miss may have been intentional on WWE's part to phase out the championship, which had been a fan-favorite entertaining segment with performers like R-Truth, Tozawa, and Dana Brooke.

stories.title: Gene Snitsky Action Figure
stories.tldr: Gene Snitsky is getting a new action figure from Title Run Toys that will feature "baby punt action" based on his infamous 2004 WWE segment where he punted a prop baby into the crowd. The figure is set to release in early fall, and Snitsky has already tested the prototype and praised the final product.

stories.title: WWE NXT Start Time August 11
stories.tldr: WWE NXT airs tonight on the CW at 8pm ET/7pm CT/5pm PT, featuring the NXT Women's North American Championship match between Zaria and Wren Sinclair. The card also includes Cruz Montana versus Grayson Waller for a number 1 contendership to the NXT Championship, plus tag team matches featuring Saquon Shugars, Dion Lennox, Niko Vance, Izzi Dame, Shawn Spears, and Lizzy Rain.

stories.title: Triple H Motivational Comments
stories.tldr: Triple H's post-SummerSlam comments telling WWE wrestlers to "work harder" and "take someone else's spot" were intended as motivation but may have backfired, according to Jonathan Coachman. Wrestlers backstage are allegedly frustrated and paranoid about their job security, feeling they're already working as hard as established stars but receiving fewer opportunities. Coachman claims the message will have a negative effect on the locker room morale rather than inspire them.

stories.title: NXT Heatwave Championship Matches
stories.tldr: NXT Heatwave on August 30 now features two title matches: Kendal Grey defending the NXT Women's Championship against Kelani Jordan, and a historic unification match between Wren Sinclair's Women's Speed Championship and Zaria's NXT Women's North American Championship. The unification stipulation appears to signal the end of the Women's Speed Championship as a standalone title.

stories.title: Bayley WWE Contract Status and AEW Speculation
stories.tldr: Despite Bayley's recent cryptic social media teasing, sources within AEW say they're confused by the whole situation and don't expect her at All In. Bryan Alvarez reports her WWE deal may not expire until January 2027, not October as previously thought, meaning she won't be available for several more months. Dave Meltzer confirms she remains unsigned to a new WWE contract and has a decision to make, with her TV status dependent on whether she re-signs.

stories.title: Nikki Cross WWE Release and Wyatt Sicks
stories.tldr: Nikki Cross has discussed her emotional attachment to the Abby the Witch character and revealed how she approached honoring Bray Wyatt's original vision while making it her own. She also purchased Progress Wrestling with her husband Big Damo, viewing the timing of her WWE release as serendipitous for the opportunity. Additionally, Cross detailed how she pitched and developed the Nikki A.S.H. character in 2021 with extensive market research and artwork.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Defends Avery Styles
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes has now publicly defended Avery Styles, arguing that AJ Styles "already set up the fn' chairs" through the sacrifices he made while raising his son. Lexis King posted a photo at the WWE Performance Center with multiple second-generation wrestlers using the same phrase, and Arik Cannon has questioned whether this sets a bad precedent for other aspiring wrestlers entering the business.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio WWE Status and AAA Connection
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio discussed his retirement timeline, revealing he doesn't feel ready to hang up his boots despite being 51, while his son Dominik claimed it's his "birthright" to retire his father. Meanwhile, Mysterio's role as AAA GM is expanding, with him orchestrating cross-promotional matches including Rey Fenix's AAA Cruiserweight Championship defense on NXT and a major lucha libre tournament for Roman Reigns' World Heavyweight Championship.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa Bloodline Return
stories.tldr: Solo Sikoa posted a resigned reaction to his forced return to the Bloodline, while WWE is also reportedly preparing to add Zilla Fatu as a new voluntary member to the faction. Beyond the Bloodline, multiple other wrestlers are expected to join various factions in coming weeks, including Chad Gable reuniting with Alpha Academy and Bronson Reed returning to the Vision.

stories.title: Bully Ray Roman Reigns Criticism
stories.tldr: Booker T has strongly defended Roman Reigns against Conrad Thompson's overrated criticism, calling him "the best damn wrestler in the world" and claiming every opponent has their best match against him. Meanwhile, Eric Bischoff clarified that his own criticism stems not from disrespect but from creative stagnation, saying he's "bored" because Roman's character hasn't evolved and WWE is maintaining rather than developing the presentation.

stories.title: Chelsea Green WWE Women's Champion
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green suffered a broken orbital bone during a SmackDown match, prompting Booker T to encourage her to push through the injury with a protective mask. Meanwhile, Green has begun concrete planning for starting a family with Matt Cardona now that she's achieved her championship goal, with the couple already discussing parenting expectations in their everyday conversations.

stories.title: Brock Rechsteiner WWE Recruitment
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer expects Brock Rechsteiner to sign with WWE within a couple months as his NFL prospects with the Saints dim following his six-game suspension. Meltzer predicts he'll be fast-tracked similarly to cousin Bron Breakker, and Rechsteiner has already signed an NIL deal with WWE and discussed the wrestling path with Breakker.

stories.title: Shiloh Hill NXT Return
stories.tldr: Shiloh Hill's recovery has progressed faster than expected, with his doctor surprised by the rapid healing of his fractured maxilla. Hill has already competed at two live events while wearing a protective mask and is now officially scheduled to face Jackson Drake on the Aug. 18 NXT episode. The match carries significant stakes, with a Drake victory earning him a shot at the NXT North American Championship and triggering tag team title matches at Heatwave.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Women's World Champion
stories.tldr: Following her WrestleMania 42 victory, Liv Morgan has engaged in a social media war with both Stephanie Vaquer and Becky Lynch. Morgan boasted about becoming the longest-reigning Women's World Champion while dismissing her challengers' availability and work ethic. Both Vaquer and Lynch are positioning themselves as next in line for the title.

stories.title: ESPN WWE Coverage
stories.tldr: ESPN host Joe Fortenbaugh detailed the network's strategy for WWE coverage, explaining the challenge of balancing wrestling storylines with mainstream appeal. The network is working to attract both hardcore fans and casual viewers by mixing in-depth match analysis with personal profiles that could resonate with non-wrestling audiences. ESPN hopes that connection points outside the ring—like Seth Rollins being a Bears fan—could help convert new viewers into regular followers.

stories.title: WWE Raw SummerSlam Fallout Viewership
stories.tldr: WWE Raw's SummerSlam fallout episode on August 3 drew 2.6 million global viewers, its best performance in 11 weeks and a significant jump from recent weeks. The episode ranked sixth globally on Netflix for the week and featured major returns including Becky Lynch and Stephanie Vaquer alongside championship moments from Roman Reigns and Oba Femi.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Commentary
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett recently made several commentary appearances discussing Vince McMahon's anticipated return to public life, Dominik Mysterio's WWE booking struggles, and comparisons between TNA and AEW. Jarrett expects McMahon to make a shocking comeback aligned with his public persona, believes Mysterio's versatility is working against his main roster positioning, and praised AEW's diverse global roster as similar to early TNA's role in developing talent.

stories.title: Blue Pants Vaudevillains Reunion
stories.tldr: Blue Pants (Leva Bates), Simon Gotch, and Matthew Rehwoldt are reuniting for a special match and appearance at Atomic Legacy Wrestling's "We Wear The Crown" event on September 12th in Lakeland, Florida. The three wrestlers were previously aligned in WWE NXT as The Vaudevillains.

stories.title: Chris Bey Supports CM Punk
stories.tldr: Chris Bey has opened up about his close friendship with WWE Champion CM Punk, revealing that Punk provided crucial emotional support during Bey's recovery from a severe neck injury in 2024 that left him with only a 10-25 percent chance of walking again. Bey, who has defied the odds and returned to his pre-injury weight, expressed deep gratitude for Punk's consistent check-ins and support, while noting that both are currently focused on fitness and helping advance the wrestling industry.

stories.title: NJPW G1 Climax Flashback
stories.tldr: Tetsuya Naito defeated Hiroshi Tanahashi in the G1 Climax 2013 Finals on August 11, 2013, in a 26-minute match that Dave Meltzer rated ****½. The match featured excellent storytelling with Tanahashi targeting Naito's surgically repaired right knee throughout, leading to back-and-forth action that culminated in Naito hitting the Stardust Press for the clean victory.

stories.title: Title Changes Wrestling History
stories.tldr: August 11th has seen 292 notable professional wrestling title changes throughout history, with significant wins including Seth Rollins capturing the WWE Universal Championship in 2019 and Rey Mysterio winning the WWE United States Title in 2023. The day's most recent title change occurred in 2025 when Masa Kitamiya and Takashi Sugiura won the GHC Heavyweight Tag Team Titles. Notable historical changes span from 1966 to present day across various wrestling promotions and championship divisions.

stories.title: WOR Vince McMahon Shareholder Lawsuit
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Radio covered Vince McMahon's portion of a WWE shareholder lawsuit payout alongside analysis of CMLL's Grand Prix 2026, New Japan's G-1 tournament updates, and Hiroyoshi Tenzan's retirement announcement. The show also included a full WWE RAW recap and audience mailbag questions. Bryan Alvarez and Dave Meltzer discussed multiple wrestling topics across promotions in their latest episode.

stories.title: Wrestling Tribalism and Reporting
stories.tldr: A wrestling news editor argues that reporters presenting personal opinions as factual news are exacerbating fandom tribalism between WWE and AEW supporters. The piece cites examples involving Dave Meltzer's WWE commentary, Conrad Thompson's Roman Reigns critique, and Chris Jericho's AEW statements, contending that both reporters and fans should exercise more restraint in promoting divisive narratives.

stories.title: Bray Wyatt Had a Side of Himself WWE Fans Rarely Got To See, Reveals Nikki Cross
stories.tldr: Nikki Cross recently shared stories about Bray Wyatt's kindness and generosity behind the scenes, revealing a compassionate person who quietly looked after his coworkers and interacted meaningfully with fans without seeking attention. Cross expressed hope that her work with The Wyatt Sicks honored Wyatt's memory, describing him as someone with great empathy who understood what others were going through.

stories.title: The Miz Details Unrealized WWE WrestleMania Pitch Involving The Ultimate Warrior
stories.tldr: The Miz pitched an ambitious WrestleMania angle where he would defeat every Intercontinental Champion in a Gauntlet Lumberjack match to prove himself the greatest IC Champion of all time, only to be defeated by The Ultimate Warrior in a dramatic finish. The plans never came to fruition, and it remains unclear exactly when the pitch was made, though it likely would have occurred during Miz's 85-day IC title reign in 2012, before Warrior's death in 2014.

stories.title: BVV: AAA with Jack Cartwheel vs. Noisy Boy; TNA with backstage stuff
stories.tldr: In a lackluster week for both TNA Impact and AAA Lucha Libre, a cruiserweight sprint between Jack Cartwheel and Noisy Boy emerged as the standout match. TNA's most compelling content occurred backstage with storyline developments involving Mustafa Ali, Leon Slater, Cedric Alexander, Nic Nemeth, and Jeff Hardy, while in-ring action featured the Knockouts TV title tournament, Matt Hardy versus Ryan Nemeth, and Xia Brookside defending the Knockouts championship against Wendy Choo. AAA presented Night 3 of Verano de Escandalo with several multi-person matches highlighting the card.

stories.title: Nattie Says Total Divas Could Return Soon as Nick Khan Hears Revival Ideas
stories.tldr: Nattie Neidhart revealed that she and The Bella Twins continue actively campaigning to revive Total Divas, with WWE President Nick Khan reportedly supportive and willing to hear their revival pitches. While no official green light has been given, Nattie suggests there is potential for the show to return soon, citing a new generation of WWE women superstars who cite the original series as inspiration for joining the company.

stories.title: More WWE Main Roster Stars To Return To NXT
stories.tldr: Following Grayson Waller's return to NXT, where he cut a promo about the brand's current state and set his sights on the NXT Championship he never won, multiple main roster stars could benefit from returning to NXT to revive their careers. Candidates include The Creed Brothers, Ivy Nile, Ilja Dragunov, Fraxiom, and Jordynne Grace, all of whom are underutilized on Raw or SmackDown.

stories.title: Bron Breakker and Logan Paul Allegedly Don’t Get Along Backstage in WWE
stories.tldr: According to Jonathan Coachman, Bron Breakker is frustrated with his creative direction in WWE, particularly as Austin Theory receives more prominent positioning within their faction. Coachman also reported that Breakker and Logan Paul don't get along well backstage, adding another layer of tension to Breakker's current situation in the company.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Dawn Marie Launches OnlyFans Account
stories.tldr: Former WWE and ECW star Dawn Marie has launched an OnlyFans account featuring exclusive content and direct fan interaction, but she has made clear boundaries that the page will only include sexy shoots and implied nudity with no explicit material. The move represents another venture for the retired wrestler who now works as a nurse specializing in dementia care, runs a crystal store, and has definitively stated she will not be returning to in-ring competition.

stories.title: Val Venis Claims ‘Hebrew Poison Jab’ Caused Triple H’s Career-Ending Cardiac Issues
stories.tldr: Val Venis has publicly claimed on Twitter that Triple H's career-ending cardiac issues in 2021 were caused by a COVID vaccine, calling it a "Hebrew poison jab" and dismissing Triple H's explanation that genetics played a role. Triple H has previously stated his heart is functioning perfectly with an implanted defibrillator that has never activated. Venis provided no evidence for his accusation, which directly contradicts Triple H's own medical explanation.

stories.title: Mickie James ALS Support
stories.tldr: Mickie James completed her Ice Bucket Challenge fundraiser at WrestleCon Minneapolis, allowing the contest winner to dump ice water on her in support of ALS research. The campaign raised funds for I AM ALS while supporting her friend Rebel Tanea Brooks, who is battling terminal ALS. James humorously noted her hatred of cold water but emphasized the importance of the cause.

stories.title: GCW Avery Styles Future
stories.tldr: GCW promoter Brett Lauderdale has publicly defended Avery Styles following the chair-setup controversy, arguing the teenager deserves the same grace as any rookie wrestler despite scrutiny from his father's fame. Lauderdale stated Avery earned his spot based on natural talent rather than privilege, having impressed him and his endorsers despite being less than a year into his wrestling career.

stories.title: Myles Borne Possibly Defending Both WWE NXT NA And Tag Team Titles At Heatwave
stories.tldr: Jackson Drake must defeat Shiloh Hill next week on NXT to earn a North American Championship match against Myles Borne at Heatwave. If Drake wins, Borne will defend both the NA and Tag Team titles on the same card. Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes' rematch for the Tag titles could be jeopardized if Drake fails to secure his opportunity.

stories.title: Report: Zilla Fatu Signs With WWE
stories.tldr: Sources report that Zilla Fatu has signed a contract with WWE following his departure from House of Glory. The 26-year-old is back at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, though the company has not yet officially announced the signing. Speculation suggests he could debut in NXT before potentially joining The Bloodline on the main roster.

stories.title: Looking At The Avery Styles Situation
stories.tldr: AJ Styles has publicly defended his son Avery after independent wrestler Arik Cannon claimed the teenager refused to help set up the ring at a GCW show in Minneapolis. AJ countered that Avery was paid as a performer, not ring crew, sparking debate over whether second-generation wrestlers have special obligations to "pay their dues" beyond in-ring work.

stories.title: WWE Names Oba Femi & Bron Breakker Confrontation As Fifth Best Raw Moment, Jey Uso’s Victory Over Solo Sikoa Named Number One
stories.tldr: WWE ranked its top 10 moments from Raw, with the Oba Femi and Bron Breakker confrontation landing at number five. The rivalry is being positioned as an imminent match that could take place at Money in the Bank, Sunday Night's Main Event, or WWE Crown Jewel rather than waiting until WrestleMania.

stories.title: AEW All Out and Dynamite Fallout Pittsburgh
stories.tldr: AEW announced that the September 30 edition of Dynamite will air live from the Petersen Events Center in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, serving as the fallout show following All Out on September 26. The event will be a standalone Dynamite broadcast, with the location for that week's Collision still to be announced. General admission tickets go on sale this Friday, August 14, with early access premium seating beginning tomorrow.

stories.title: Mick Foley AEW Transition
stories.tldr: Mick Foley has transitioned from WWE to AEW and credits the move to the company's enthusiasm and the owner's genuine passion for the product. After taking a break from wrestling when his children moved out, Foley noticed AEW's energy contrasted sharply with WWE's corporate approach. He appreciates working in an environment where the owner is visibly happy and thankful for his performers' hard work.

stories.title: MJF Creative Influence in AEW
stories.tldr: According to recent reports, MJF has significant creative influence over his own storylines in AEW, though his input appears limited to programs he is directly involved in rather than affecting other main event wrestlers. While some wrestlers reportedly view talent creative influence negatively, the company has long been aware of MJF's substantial role in booking decisions for his own feuds.

stories.title: Ace Austin AEW Interest
stories.tldr: Despite losing to Claudio Castagnoli in the Continental Challenge Cup, Ace Austin impressed people within AEW with his performance. Dave Meltzer reported that Austin's work has generated internal discussion and could lead to more television time, though primarily in enhancement matches. Austin remains winless in AEW singles competition at 1-9 overall.

stories.title: CM Punk AEW History Column
stories.tldr: CM Punk's AEW Championship victory at Double or Nothing 2022 drew a sellout crowd of 14,459 fans and generated the largest non-WWE gate in North American pro wrestling history at just under $1.15 million, despite the show facing competition from NBA Finals Game Seven and only achieving around 165,000 PPV buys. While the MJF situation generated significant online buzz, it did not substantially impact buyrate projections, though Punk's main event performance dominated search interest on the day of the show.

stories.title: MVP AEW World Title Opportunity Rejection
stories.tldr: MVP clarified he would reject an AEW World Championship offer from Tony Khan, citing both physical limitations and lack of desire to carry the company's top title. The Hurt Syndicate manager explained he's unwilling to commit to the grueling schedule and main-event responsibility that comes with being world champion, preferring to limit singles matches to 8-12 minutes rather than the 20-25 minutes expected of a titleholder.

stories.title: MVP AEW Career and Retirement
stories.tldr: MVP revealed that WWE's toxic backstage culture and his unhappiness with management, not money, drove him to leave the company. He turned down a lucrative five-year deal from John Laurinaitis, preferring to depart on good terms so he could return if needed. He contrasted WWE's grueling 250-day road schedule with the freedom he found in Japan before joining AEW.

stories.title: Daniel Garcia Jon Moxley Death Riders
stories.tldr: Daniel Garcia has elaborated further on Jon Moxley's impact on AEW, crediting him with reversing the company's downward trajectory. Garcia hinted at untold details of Moxley's decisive intervention while praising how the company has rebounded from its 2023-2024 slump. Moxley's title reigns and leadership of the Death Riders have been instrumental in restoring fan confidence in AEW's alternative identity.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo MJF AEW
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo posted photos of receiving stitches after his AEW Grand Slam Mexico match and confirmed he's taking time off to recover, though he stressed the injury isn't serious. MJF mockingly responded on social media, seemingly taking credit for the attack that sidelined his rival.

stories.title: Eddie Kingston AEW Collision
stories.tldr: Disco Inferno has criticized Eddie Kingston following his Continental Challenge Cup return, claiming Kingston "refuses to do the work to not look like a slob" and suggesting his career momentum hasn't recovered since a previous incident involving body shaming comments from Sammy Guevara.

stories.title: AEW All In London 2026 Debuts
stories.tldr: Beyond the previously reported returns of Buddy Matthews, Keith Lee, Ruby Soho and Dr Britt Baker, AEW is eyeing eight additional debuts ahead of All In London 2026. The potential signings include major free agents like Sheamus, Dakota Kai (now Charlie), and Kairi Sane, plus rising stars Leon Slater from TNA and several other independent wrestlers who could reshape the roster for the Wembley event.

stories.title: Royce Keys Injury Angle
stories.tldr: Royce Keys has been sidelined indefinitely following a brutal attack by Jacob Fatu on the August 3 episode of WWE Raw. Michael Cole announced on August 10 that Keys is suffering from a bruised larynx and cervical strain sustained during their Street Fight match and the post-match assault. The injury is reported to be storyline-based rather than a legitimate injury to cover.

stories.title: WWE European Tour 2027
stories.tldr: WWE announced an eight-show European tour running January 15-25, 2027, featuring four televised episodes (two Raw, two SmackDown) and four house shows across seven countries in preparation for Royal Rumble 2027. The tour marks historic firsts including Raw in Dublin, SmackDown in Belgium, WWE's first event in Poland, and returns to multiple markets after years of absence.

stories.title: CM Punk NXT House Show Appearance
stories.tldr: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk has been announced for an NXT live event on Saturday, August 15, 2026, at the VSU Multipurpose Center in Petersburg, Virginia. Punk revealed the appearance via Instagram Stories, and while WWE has not specified what role he will play, he joins a card featuring NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo, NXT Women's Champion Kendal Grey, and several other developmental talent. The appearance marks a significant boost for the house show, which had distributed 1,261 tickets as of the announcement.

stories.title: WWE RAW August 17 Preview
stories.tldr: WWE has announced two tournament matches for the August 17 episode of Monday Night Raw, both aimed at determining the next number one contender for the WWE World Heavyweight Championship. Rey Fenix will face El Fiscal while Dragon Lee takes on El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. in qualifying matches. Additionally, WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns will return to the red brand after missing the previous week's show.

stories.title: Penta World Heavyweight Title Tournament
stories.tldr: Penta advanced in the World Heavyweight Championship Number One Contender's Tournament on WWE Raw by defeating AAA's Laredo Kid with a Mexican Destroyer finisher. The tournament will determine who faces Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship at WWE Raw in Mexico City on September 14. Penta will face either Psycho Clown or LA Parka in the next round, with the possibility of facing his brother Rey Fenix in the finals.

stories.title: ESPN WWE Partnership
stories.tldr: ESPN is still in the exploratory phase of its WWE partnership, determining how best to balance hardcore wrestling fan coverage with mainstream sports content that could attract new audiences. A recent change saw ESPN not air the first hour of SummerSlam for free on linear television, with conflicting reports attributing the decision to either scheduling conflicts or disappointment in streaming subscription growth.

stories.title: Oba Femi vs Bron Breakker Feud
stories.tldr: WWE is positioned to book Oba Femi against Bron Breakker following a teaser on Raw, with the match representing an ideal way to revive Breakker's stalled momentum while testing Femi's credentials as the next big thing. However, wrestling analysts including Jeff Jarrett have raised concerns that Femi's underdeveloped promo skills and personality remain a potential obstacle to him becoming a true main event draw and ticket seller.

stories.title: Maxxine Dupri WWE and Netflix Series
stories.tldr: Maxxine Dupri defended WWE's Netflix series "Unreal" against fan criticism, arguing that viewers are only seeing a small fraction of the year-round footage captured and that people who dislike it simply shouldn't watch. The comments came as Dupri discussed her recent heel turn, where she's now able to express frustrations built up over three years on WWE's main roster.

stories.title: Chris Jericho Wrestling Era Comparison
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho recently discussed the most significant difference between WWE's Attitude Era and modern professional wrestling, attributing the former period's enduring popularity to the presence of approximately 12 legitimate main event draws who possessed iconic star power. Jericho highlighted that while today's wrestling has more exposure through streaming platforms, it lacks the caliber of marquee talent that simultaneously existed during the late 1990s and early 2000s, which included The Rock, Stone Cold Steve Austin, The Undertaker, Mankind, Triple H, Kurt Angle, Chris Benoit, Kane, and Big Show. Jericho made these comments during an interview while promoting his "Vietslam" documentary and preparing for a TNT Championship challenge against Kevin Knight.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio Championship Opportunity
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio has earned another shot at WWE gold as he accepted a challenge from Intercontinental Champion Chad Gable for an August 10 episode of WWE RAW. This opportunity comes while Mysterio serves as the first-ever on-screen General Manager of Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide, a role that has strengthened the connection between WWE and AAA. The match carries significant history between the two wrestlers, particularly following Gable's transformation from mocking Lucha Libre traditions to becoming a respectful advocate for the culture.

stories.title: Jey Uso vs Solo Sikoa and Roman Reigns Storyline
stories.tldr: Jey Uso defeated Solo Sikoa on Raw with Jimmy Uso's interference, forcing Solo to be "delivered" to Roman Reigns next week. This marks another step in the Bloodline's reformation as Roman rebuilds the stable with the Usos and Jacob Fatu. However, critics question whether the storyline is retreading old ground after six years of similar Bloodline dominance angles.

stories.title: Liv Morgan vs Becky Lynch Title Program
stories.tldr: Liv Morgan attacked Becky Lynch during a tense segment on Monday Night Raw that also featured Stephanie Vaquer challenging for the WWE Women's World Championship. The confrontation escalated when both Morgan and Vaquer turned on each other, allowing the champion to escape without being caught. The segment strongly suggests WWE is building toward a three-way championship match involving all three women.

stories.title: WWE Travel Schedule and Talent Wellness
stories.tldr: Maxxine Dupri has opened up about WWE's grueling travel schedule, describing it as both a blessing and a curse that fans cannot fully understand without experiencing it firsthand. The 29-year-old wrestler also defended WWE: Unreal against criticism, arguing that viewers can simply choose not to watch the Netflix show and that it only provides a small glimpse of the full year of footage filmed.

stories.title: Sol Ruca Tag Team Match on RAW
stories.tldr: Sol Ruca will face off against Judgment Day members Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez in a tag team match on WWE Raw, seeking revenge after losing her Women's Intercontinental Championship and being attacked by the group. The identity of her mystery partner remains unknown, with several potential candidates including IYO SKY, Stephanie Vaquer, Becky Lynch, Lola Vice, AJ Lee, and Bayley.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair New Alliance
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair has formed a new alliance with Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley on SmackDown and is inviting WWE fans to help name the faction. The trio came together during the August 7 episode when they combined forces to defeat Jade Cargill and The Baddies. Flair posted on social media asking "What would YOU call us?" and has been enthusiastically engaging with fan suggestions for the group's official branding.

stories.title: Raquel Rodriguez and Judgment Day
stories.tldr: Raquel Rodriguez, the Women's Intercontinental Champion and current Judgment Day member, has identified Omos as an ideal recruit for the stable. Rodriguez believes the towering presence would serve as valuable muscle for the group, though Omos is currently pursuing opportunities in AAA alongside Dominik Mysterio and has been working internationally in promotions like Pro Wrestling NOAH.

stories.title: Bayley AEW Speculation
stories.tldr: Bayley has fueled speculation about potentially joining AEW by posting a cryptic Instagram training montage captioned "all or nothing, baby" featuring work with Mercedes Mone and set to AEW's "All In" theme song. Her absence from WWE television since losing to Lyra Valkyria in July has intensified rumors about her contract status, with her deal expiring in October and her future uncertain.

stories.title: Becky Lynch WWE Career Reflection
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch reflected on her overwhelming experience performing in front of over 100,000 fans at her WrestleMania 32 debut in 2016, noting she had never been in such a large stadium before. The Irish wrestler has since become accustomed to performing in stadiums multiple times per year and named Bianca Belair and Asuka as her favorite career opponents.

stories.title: Ricky Saints WWE Main Roster
stories.tldr: Ricky Saints, several months into his WWE SmackDown tenure, remains optimistic about his main roster journey despite limited TV time. The wrestler has already toured Europe extensively and maintains a manifesting mindset about his future success. His immediate goal is to wrestle in his hometown's Superdome in New Orleans, followed by winning the US Championship and WWE Championship.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett WWE SummerSlam Prediction
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett predicts that Saturday will become WWE SummerSlam's top night going forward, arguing that the SummerSlam brand itself now attracts fans more than individual match cards. Jarrett, who previously served as WWE Senior Vice President of Live Events, believes travel logistics and the destination-weekend concept favor Saturday shows, as fans can attend and return home the next day without extending their trips.

stories.title: WWE RAW Search Interest Analysis
stories.tldr: WWE Raw's Google search interest increased 3% over the last 90 days compared to the previous quarter, driven largely by strong viewership metrics following SummerSlam. However, the year-over-year comparison reveals a concerning 10% decline from the same period last year, attributed to casual viewer fatigue after Netflix's streaming transition. The June 29 episode peaked at 100/100 search interest, while the August 3 post-SummerSlam Raw reached 75/100, marking the strongest performance since early July.

stories.title: WWE RAW August 10, 2026 Review
stories.tldr: Jey Uso defeated Solo Sikoa in the RAW main event, earning the right to deliver his brother to Roman Reigns next week. Chad Gable challenged Rey Mysterio for the Intercontinental Championship, while the World Heavyweight title tournament continued with Penta advancing and additional first-round matches set for August 17.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Interim Championship and Injury
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green revealed details about her marketing strategy of taking titles to external appearances that WWE didn't understand, discussed her ambitions to start a family now that she's achieved her championship goal, and opened up about her emotional dedication of the SummerSlam win to Michael Hayes—comments made before her orbital bone injury was revealed to have occurred during Fatal Influence's finishing move.

stories.title: Blake Monroe WWE Career and Debut
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe has responded with humor to fan criticism about not wrestling on the main roster, joking that she's content getting paid to eat donuts. She's also opened up about personal topics in recent interviews, including why she advises wrestlers against dating each other, turning down Love Island twice, and sharing her candid thoughts on living in America versus her native England.

stories.title: AJ Styles WWE Retirement and Lola Vice NXT
stories.tldr: AJ Styles revealed he would only consider coming out of retirement for a major match teaming with his sons, not for indie shows, and he must still be young enough to do it. He also confirmed he served as a producer alongside Johnny Moss for Lola Vice's NXT Underground championship farewell match against Kendal Grey.

stories.title: Elijah Holyfield AAA Transition
stories.tldr: WWE's decision to send Elijah Holyfield to AAA is strategic rather than developmental—the company aims to build him as a standalone AAA star rather than a temporary visitor from the main roster. With established Mexican talent like Penta and Fenix already splitting time between AAA and RAW/SmackDown, WWE wants Holyfield to become an identity-defining figure for the AAA brand itself, working under The Undertaker's creative direction.

stories.title: John Cena WWE Contract and Retirement
stories.tldr: John Cena signed a five-year ambassadorial deal with WWE following his December 2025 retirement, locking him into the company through an extended contract. He has hosted WrestleMania 42 and made appearances at major events to promote WWE initiatives. The John Cena Classic tournament, featuring wrestlers across Raw, SmackDown, and NXT with fan voting to determine the winner, remains targeted for December 2026 though the exact date is subject to change.

stories.title: CM Punk Undisputed Championship and Kevin Owens Feud
stories.tldr: Analysis suggests the CM Punk-Kevin Owens feud carries unique psychological weight due to their shared history dating back to 2005 Ring of Honor, with Owens being one of the few competitors who can genuinely get inside Punk's head. Finn Balor expressed personal happiness at Owens' return from a serious 17-month neck injury, though the surprise addition cost Balor his shot at the Undisputed Championship.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio WWE Push
stories.tldr: Finn Balor offered high praise for Dominik Mysterio during an appearance in Ireland, calling him "annoyingly cool" and predicting he'll become an even bigger star. Meanwhile, Mysterio will defend his AAA Mega Championship against Ludwig Kaiser at the two-night Triplemania event in September, with shows taking place in Las Vegas and Mexico City.

stories.title: Bron Breakker WWE Recruitment
stories.tldr: Brock Rechsteiner, cousin of Bron Breakker and son of Scott Steiner, has been suspended six games by the NFL after violating the performance-enhancing substance policy with the New Orleans Saints. Despite the setback to his football career, WWE's reported 99.9% interest in signing him once his NFL stint ends remains a strong possibility for the Steiner family's next wrestling prospect.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Roster Adjustments
stories.tldr: WWE is expected to move multiple SmackDown wrestlers to RAW within the next month to balance the rosters following the call-ups of Tatum Paxley and Lola Vice. The company aims to even out both brands rather than simply stacking talent on one show. Details on which stars will be traded have not yet been revealed, but the shift could happen soon.

stories.title: Joe Gacy WWE Release
stories.tldr: Joe Gacy has revealed new details about the lead-up to his April WWE release, explaining that the Wyatt Sicks saw warning signs weeks before being cut. The group's plans were scrapped during WrestleMania week, and they were even abruptly canceled off a scheduled SmackDown appearance with their travel arrangements dropped last-minute, making the eventual mass release less shocking than it might have seemed.

stories.title: Mickie James Nick Aldis WWE
stories.tldr: Mickie James reflected on Nick Aldis's SummerSlam appearance and revealed how their son Donovan was deeply invested in the journey, documenting his father's training. James reaffirmed her previous interest in seeing Aldis face Randy Orton, Cody Rhodes, and Drew McIntyre, while emphasizing that Aldis's WWE opportunity felt like a destined moment after years of uncertainty.

stories.title: Wrestling History and Legends
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash shared an emotional conversation with Jim Ross and Jerry Lawler ahead of JR's brain surgery, reflecting on their shared losses and determination to keep living. Meanwhile, Ric Flair clarified that he and Wendy Barlow are renewing their 34-year friendship rather than rekindling their romantic relationship, as she has moved to Tampa to care for her elderly parents.

stories.title: Wrestling Podcast and Radio Coverage
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Live and Radio covered major storylines including CM Punk vs. Kevin Owens from Friday's Smackdown and upcoming RAW programming, while also discussing All In ticket sales, international tournament updates, and injury news. WWE RAW airs tonight from Norfolk, Virginia at 8pm ET, featuring a World Heavyweight Championship Number One Contenders Tournament match, Stephanie Vaquer's return segment, and several other announced bouts.

stories.title: FTR RevPro British Tag Titles Challenge
stories.tldr: FTR will make their Revolution Pro Wrestling debut on August 29 at the company's 14th anniversary show, challenging Cowboy Way for the Undisputed British Tag Team Championships. The match was changed from an original encounter with The Young Guns after Ethan Allen suffered a serious knee injury. The event takes place one day before AEW All In at Wembley, and FTR are not currently scheduled for that show after a hiatus following their AEW tag title loss in May.

stories.title: WWE Talent Debuts AAA
stories.tldr: Following WWE's acquisition of AAA last year, multiple WWE talents are expected to make their debuts for the Mexican promotion. NXT's Drake Morreaux recently debuted with a masked gimmick, and several other WWE stars including Elijah Holyfield, Ilja Dragunov, Johnny Gargano, Candice LeRae, Giulia, and Tama and Talla Tonga are candidates to appear for AAA in the coming months.

stories.title: Big Van Tater Viral Appearance
stories.tldr: Big Van Tater went viral at Southern Honor Wrestling's RumbleJack battle royal after making a memorable entrance paying tribute to Vader while wearing a microwave on his head. The unique appearance caught the attention of wrestling personalities including Nyla Rose and John Layfield, with fans and wrestlers praising Tater as an incredible new indie star.

stories.title: Dwayne Johnson Disney Legends
stories.tldr: Disney+ and Hulu are bringing D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event to streaming audiences worldwide, with exclusive panels and presentations available to subscribers both in Anaheim and at home. The Disney Legends Awards Ceremony, which will feature Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson's induction, will stream on Disney+ beginning at 6 pm PT on August 16. The event includes multiple celebrity panels, concert celebrations, and immersive experiences throughout the weekend.

stories.title: Val Venis Comes Out As Trans-World Champion
stories.tldr: Val Venis posted a satirical message on Facebook claiming to identify as a "33 time WWE World Champion" with pronouns of "CHAMP & GOAT," which appears to be a mocking response to ongoing discussions about trans issues. The post comes amid Venis's history of controversial right-wing political statements, including previous criticism of LGBTQ+ advocacy and other divisive topics that have generated significant backlash on social media.

stories.title: CM Punk Says One Of His Favorite WWE Matches Is Overlooked By Fans
stories.tldr: CM Punk discussed his WWE WrestleMania 29 match against The Undertaker on the Games With Names podcast, arguing that the match is underrated and deserves more recognition from fans. Despite competing in other notable matches throughout his WWE career, Punk believes his clash with The Undertaker and The Streak was one of his greatest performances and represented a massive moment in WWE history that shouldn't be overlooked.

stories.title: Daily Update: AJPW, GCW-Avery Styles, WWE European tour
stories.tldr: WWE is scheduling European tour dates for January 2027 with Raw episodes in Glasgow and Dublin strategically timed to avoid conflicts with major sporting events. All Japan Pro Wrestling is being dissolved and merged into a real estate company owned by the promotion's president for corporate purposes. Tonight's Raw from Norfolk features multiple title contender matches and will be sold out with over 8,400 tickets distributed.

stories.title: TNA's Mustafa Ali Explains Thought Process Behind Recent Addition To Order 4
stories.tldr: TNA's Mustafa Ali recently added Mila Moore to his Order 4 stable to help manage internal faction issues and conflicts. Ali praised Moore's ability to command attention and noted that since her July 16 introduction, iMPACT has achieved record viewership numbers. The stable leader described Order 4 as the most developed character act in the company, citing complex storylines involving sobriety, past rivalries, and upcoming angles with Jason Hotch.

stories.title: Former WWE Star’s New Ring Name Revealed, Set For Upcoming Major Tournament
stories.tldr: Dante Chen, a former WWE NXT star released in April 2026, has revealed his new ring name "The Southeast Asian Standout" CHEN and will make his Pro Wrestling NOAH debut as part of the N-1 Victory Tournament's A Block. Chen, who primarily worked as an enhancement talent on NXT Level Up, will represent Singapore in the tournament while facing top NOAH competitors and fellow ex-WWE NXT stars. This opportunity comes after Chen competed once under the ring name Trexxus for CCW in July, marking a significant step forward in his post-WWE career.

stories.title: GCW Arik Cannon Avery Styles Controversy
stories.tldr: GCW issued an official statement distancing itself from Arik Cannon's criticism of Avery Styles, clarifying that Cannon speaks only for himself and not the promotion. Cannon has since escalated his argument by sharing photos of Cody Rhodes and Jimmy Hart performing crew duties at independent shows, using them as examples that even major wrestling names help with setup work.

stories.title: Can’t Knock The Hustle: Roman Reigns, Conrad Thompson & The Overrated Conversation
stories.tldr: Thompson's debate with fans has centered on whether Roman's success since 2020 is attributable to Heyman's management or Roman's own abilities. A deeper analysis shows that unlike classic manager-wrestler pairings where managers did most of the talking, Roman has been a significant voice in his own promos, suggesting his character would have succeeded with or without Heyman. Thompson also highlights questions about Roman's earlier WWE career that deserve examination alongside his post-2020 transformation.

stories.title: Confirmed For Tonight’s Episode Of WWE RAW On Netflix
stories.tldr: WWE RAW on Netflix airs live tonight from Norfolk, Virginia at 8 PM ET, featuring several matches including a World Heavyweight Championship #1 Contender's Tournament match between Laredo Kid and Penta, plus a tag team match with The Judgment Day taking on Sol Ruca and a partner of her choosing.
